title: Rhinestone Embellished Chiffon Ruffle Sleeve Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Step into elegance with our Rhinestone Embellished Chiffon Ruffle Sleeve Wedding Guest Dress! This stunning piece features delicate ruffle sleeves adorned with sparkling rhinestones, creating a perfect blend of sophistication and charm. The flowing chiffon fabric ensures comfort while you celebrate love in style!


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Maxi.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is non-stretch.
